item.description:
# User API

A REST API built with **TypeScript**, **Express**, **SQLite**, **bcrypt**, and **JWT authentication**.

This project was created to practice backend development, REST API design, and API testing with Postman. It demonstrates user management, authentication, input validation, and a structured API testing approach.

---

## Features

### User Management

- Create user
    
- Get all users
    
- Get user by ID
    
- Update user (PUT)
    
- Partially update user (PATCH)
    
- Delete user
    

### Authentication

- User login
    
- Password hashing with bcrypt
    
- JWT authentication
    
- Protected profile endpoint
    

### Validation

- Required field validation
    
- Username length validation
    
- Email format validation
    
- Password complexity validation
    
- Duplicate email validation
    

---

## Technologies

- Node.js
    
- TypeScript
    
- Express.js
    
- SQLite
    
- better-sqlite3
    
- bcrypt
    
- JSON Web Token (JWT)
    
- Postman
    

---

## API Endpoints

### Health Check

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| GET | `/health` |

### Users

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/users` | Create user |
| GET | `/users` | Get all users |
| GET | `/users/:id` | Get user by ID |
| PUT | `/users/:id` | Update user |
| PATCH | `/users/:id` | Partially update user |
| DELETE | `/users/:id` | Delete user |

### Authentication

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| POST | `/login` |
| GET | `/profile` _(JWT required)_ |

---

## Postman Test Collection

A complete Postman collection is included to validate the API.

### Covered Scenarios

#### Health Check

- API availability
    

#### User Registration

Positive test:

- Create user with valid data
    

Negative tests:

- Duplicate email
    
- Missing username
    
- Missing email
    
- Missing password
    
- Invalid email format
    
- Username too short
    
- Password too short
    
- Password missing uppercase letter
    
- Password missing lowercase letter
    
- Password missing number
    
- Password missing special character
    

#### User Management

- Get all users
    
- Update user
    
- Update non-existing user
    
- Patch user
    
- Delete user
    
- Verify deleted user
    

#### Authentication

Positive test:

- Login with valid credentials
    

Negative tests:

- Wrong password
    
- Unknown email
    
- Missing email
    
- Missing password
    

#### Protected Routes

Positive test:

- Access profile with valid JWT
    

Negative tests:

- Missing token
    
- Invalid token
    

---

## Installation

Clone the repository:

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/ayeromina/user-api.git

 ```

Go to the project folder:

``` bash
cd user-api

 ```

Install dependencies:

``` bash
npm install

 ```

---

## Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file in the project root:

``` env
JWT_SECRET=your_secret_key

 ```

---

## Running the Project

Start the development server:

``` bash
npm run dev

 ```

The API runs on:

```
http://localhost:3000

 ```

---

## Project Structure

```
user-api/
│
├── src/
├── README.md
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── postman/
    ├── User API.postman_collection.json
    └── User API.postman_environment.json

 ```

---

## Future Improvements

- Newman CLI integration
    
- GitHub Actions CI/CD
    
- Automated API testing pipeline
    
- Test reporting
    
- Database migrations
    
- Docker support
    

---

## Author

**Anastasiia Yeromina**

QA Engineer with 5 years of experience, currently expanding into Technical QA, API testing, backend development, and test automation.
